regions.merged_text: Mrs. Mary Ross 59 of Brown City, dying of Cancer of stomach was enrolled May 5th. At once she began to improve. Doctors had neglected her and consequently her digestion was so bad that for that reason she had to go to hospital In five weeks she was home in perfect health. Not yet Catholic. Mar. 30, 1931 Still in perfect health.

regions.merged_text: Tuesday. Diphtheria & Double Quinsy Cured over phone. (From Jos F. Droste's letter) 111-2-'28 You will remember that about noon last Wednesday Dec. 28th I called you by phone Mrs. Droste was at the point of death, suffering from a severe case of diphtheria combined with double quinsy. The doctor held very little hope of re- covery . He was almost certain that death would occur before mid- night. . Thank God ..... about 7 o'clock Wednesday evening she was relieved and ate a small amount of food. - The quinsy just disapeared .She is now on her feet and doing well .. . .!! . "Again on Friday evening Dec. 30th at about 9 o'clock P.M. I called you for prayers for my Daughter Mildred who was dying of Diptheria. "You assured me we would have a happy New Year."
